lcoe_source: IRENA, Renewable Power Generation Costs (2018, 2020, 2023, 2024 editions) — global weighted-average LCOE, utility-scale solar PV, year of commissioning.
module_price_source: Nemet (2009); Farmer & Lafond (2016); IRENA — via Our World in Data, inflation-adjusted 2024 USD.
lcoe_comparison_source: Lazard, Levelized Cost of Energy Analysis (v3.0, 2009 vs v16.0, 2023), mean unsubsidized LCOE by technology, as compiled in the World Nuclear Industry Status Report 2023. A different methodology/source than the IRENA solar series above — shown for order-of-magnitude context only, not a like-for-like comparison.
